artworks.title: La vielle méthode
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classroom setting with a teacher at a podium and students at desks. The teacher is standing at a raised desk, pointing with one hand and holding an object in the other hand. Some students are seated to the left, facing a wall with papers. One student has a grimacing expression. The illustration suggests a commentary on educational practices, with a humorous or critical take on traditional teaching methods. The drawing is detailed with cross-hatching and lines, typical of 19th-century satirical illustrations.

artworks.title: Un jeune homme pour qui rien n'est sacre
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of two people in the foreground, with additional figures in the background. In the foreground, a man sits at a desk, looking down with a focused expression. A boy stands behind him holding papers. In the background, more children in similar clothing are standing behind desks, observing the scene. The setting seems to be an educational environment with desks and papers.

artworks.title: Le leçon d'histoire
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a classroom scene featuring a teacher and a student. The image depicts a teacher leaning over a podium with a book open in front of him, addressing a student standing in front of him. The student has a bowed posture and is holding an object reminiscent of a notebook or papers. In the background, several other figures are seated, possibly other students, partially obscured by shadows and lines creating a sense of depth. The artwork is in the style of Honoré Daumier. The scene captures a classic academic moment.

artworks.title: Un jeune homme en train d'acquérir ... un art d'agrément
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Three figures are depicted from the waist up, engaged in a musical practice. To the left is a young man playing a French horn, with focused facial expression and short, tousled hair. In the center, an older man with curly hair and a mustache, wearing a coat and glasses, reads from a sheet of music while holding a clarinet. To the right, another young man plays an oboe with a concentrated expression. He has short hair and wears a suit jacket. An open music stand displays the sheet music, with a shaded wall and a framed picture in the background.

artworks.title: C'est l'apollon du nouvel opéra
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is an image showing two men looking at artwork in a gallery or museum. There is a sculpture on a pedestal in the center, surrounded by smaller sculptural works in the background. The figures in the image have exaggerated expressions as they observe the sculpture. The setting is an indoor art space with various artworks. Text below the image might be a caption or commentary.

artworks.title: Comment se termine ... une conversation conugale
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of two individuals in an indoor setting. On the left, a man sits on a sofa with his body reclined and legs extended. He has a stout body, aged facial features, closely cropped hair, and his hands on his abdomen. On the right, a woman sits on a chair with her legs hidden by a gown. She has her hands clasped in her lap, a leaning posture, full facial features, and styled hair. The woman wears a detailed dress, and both figures are in formal attire. A framed portrait hangs above the woman, depicting a person with similar hair styling. The background features patterned wallpaper and a carpeted floor.

artworks.title: Je voudrais bien savoir quel est ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene featuring three figures. The drawing depicts two men wearing towels or drapes, standing indoors with a pool or bath in the background, where additional figures are swimming. One figure is seated on a bench in the foreground. The other two figures are positioned with their backs to the observer, one tall and skinny, while the other is a rotund figure. The environment suggests an interior sports or leisure facility. The drawing style is reminiscent of 19th-century satirical art, with exaggerated forms. The accompanying French text translates to a question regarding who first claimed man to be the king of creation.

artworks.title: La cinquième acte a la gaité
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image is a monochromatic illustration of a group of people seated closely together in a theater box. The central figure is a woman with dark hair styled in a bun, wearing a striped dress with long sleeves. To her left, a young child is leaning over the railing, propped on their elbows. To the woman's right, a man with pronounced facial features is leaning forward intently. The group includes several other individuals, each exhibiting distinct expressions of boredom or tiredness, indicated by their slumped posture and resting heads. Most are wearing formal attire. The balcony box decoration is ornate, with a floral motif, and the background is a shaded interior space.

artworks.title: Le spectacle est une chose bonne pour le peuple de Paris ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people standing closely together. One person is a child seated on the shoulders of an adult man, holding onto the man's head for support. The child has short, slightly tousled hair. The man carrying the child has a rounded face and is wearing a loose-fitting jacket. Other people in the crowd include an older man with a pronounced nose and a tall hat, and several others of varying ages, mostly wearing hats. The scene is drawn in a dark, shaded style. The background is indistinct and appears to be part of a larger crowd.

artworks.title: Sainte Rosette Tamisier ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures interacting. One figure wears a cone hat and a cloak with text, while the other figure has wings, wears a robe with text, and has an animalistic face. The first figure has extended arms, while the second figure has long limbs and fingers, only showing their feet in a dramatic pose. The illustration style and theme suggest critique or satire related to religious or societal themes.

artworks.title: V'la pourtant ma femme qui s'en va ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure observing a train. The figure is standing on rough terrain, possibly a hill or a field, observing a steam train moving through a vast landscape. The train appears on the right, moving away from the observer, emitting steam into the sky. The environment is depicted with dynamic lines suggesting movement and the texture of the landscape, which includes areas of vegetation and open space. The overall tone is monochrome, rendered in shades of black and gray.

artworks.title: Francois, votre cousin le pompier est venu ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals standing next to each other. The person on the left is a woman stirring something in a pot on the stove. She is dressed in a long dress with rolled-up sleeves. The person on the right, a man, is holding a bowl close to his face. He wears spectacles and has facial hair. The background features a kitchen setting with shelves holding pots and pans, and a partially visible chair.

artworks.title: Saprelotte ... Complet! ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene featuring two individuals trying to catch a stagecoach in the rain. The artwork displays a bustling urban scene with a coach marked "complet" indicating it is full, moving away along a cobbled street lined with tall, narrow buildings. The figures, dressed in mid-19th-century attire, appear to be caught in the wind and rain. The stippled shading and detailed line work are characteristic of engravings from this period. The expressive gestures and composition suggest an illustration style reminiscent of Honoré Daumier.

artworks.title: Oui! Puisque je trouve un ami si fidèle ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals standing close to each other. The person on the left is facing the viewer with their head turned to the side, showing a nose and curly hair. They wear a draped garment and have a cloth on their shoulder. The person on the right is leaning forward with an upward gaze, showing a round face with a mustache, curly hair, and a surprised expression. They wear a similar garment and have their hand on the shoulder of the person on the left. The background shows lightly sketched text resembling a printed page.

artworks.title: Un citoyen exaspéré par les buffleteries
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man in a dramatic pose, waving a sword and throwing a military-style hat into the air. The drawing portrays an illustration of a man in a buttoned uniform with an expression on his face, swinging a sword above his head. Another hat seems to fly off to the side, suggesting a sense of action. Lines around the figure emphasize the movement, and the man's clothing flares outward, adding to the image’s energy. The artwork uses bold lines to depict emotion and drama, typical of caricature illustrations. This image is printed with monochromatic tones and has a caption in French.

artworks.title: Cérémonie imposante du scrutin
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a satirical assembly scene. The artwork humorously depicts an exaggerated and comical version of a formal assembly with figures in the top half. Their facial features are exaggerated for comedic effect. Below, three figures are each holding a glass in a different style, humorously interpreting the act of drinking. The drawing is rendered in black and white, with expressive lines and shading that bring out the humorous and exaggerated expressions of the figures. This is in the style of Honoré Daumier, known for his satirical caricatures of political figures and social scenes in 19th century France.

artworks.title: Soirée chez M. Dupin
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two separate scenes depicting caricatures of public figures. The upper scene labeled "Physionomie de l'Assemblée" portrays a group in what appears to be a parliamentary or assembly setting. The lower scene titled "Queue pour la tribune publique" shows a line of similarly caricatured figures waiting in a snowy environment. The artwork by its style suggests a mid-19th century caricature commonly used to critique or humorize societal and political figures.

artworks.title: Achille Vèron se retirant sous sa tente
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures standing in different postures. The larger figure on the right is standing dominantly with a raised leg, while the smaller figure on the left is retreating into a tent. The larger figure wears a helmet and has facial hair, carrying a shield labeled "PATE DE REGNAULT" and a feather-like object. They have a large torso. Both figures wear Romanesque or Greek warrior-style outfits with tunics and sandals. The background shows a tent with drapes.

artworks.title: Seul costume ...approprié a ce personnage
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a character in a clown costume standing with arms slightly bent and hands open. The character has a painted smile, circular eyes, and wears a pointed hat, a clown-like collar, a buttoned tunic, and puffy pantaloons. Papers with titles like "MESSAGER DE LA SEMAINE," "LE NATIONAL DE 1830," and "CONSTITUTIONNEL DE 1850" are scattered below. The background contains text, including the word "ACTUALITÉS."

artworks.title: Prochaine ordannace du préfet de police
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of riders on horseback with large bells on their saddles, in the style of Honoré Daumier. The scene features a congested street scene with caricatured horse riders, wearing top hats, and horses with oversized bells. The riders are navigating through other characters in the scene. The drawing includes exaggerated features and humorous interactions. At the bottom of the drawing, there is text referring to a police prefect ordinance related to equipping bells on vehicles. The detailed lines and expressive figures reflect the artist's style known for humor and critique.

artworks.title: Membres de la société de secours du Dix-Décembre ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures engaged in a physical confrontation. Two figures are standing with wooden clubs raised, while the third figure is on the ground. The background shows a vague crowd. The image conveys movement and emotion effectively, highlighting the intensity of the scene.

artworks.title: Ell me plait beaucoup ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows the upper bodies of two men and one woman. The two men are positioned closely together on the left side, each wearing a top hat and dark suits. Their faces have exaggerated features, one with a large nose and both with pronounced chins and bushy sideburns. Both men are facing towards the right, appearing engaged in conversation. They are dressed in 19th-century attire, with one wearing a scarf. A woman is partially visible in the background on the right side, with long, braided hair and a shawl over her shoulders. The background is a simple sketch without detailed scenery, set in a newspaper-style format with text above and below the illustration.

artworks.title: Le morceau qu'on obligé d'avalier ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals, with three adults standing and one child playing the piano. The adults are dressed in formal attire from an older era and have defined facial features with exaggerated expressions. The child is seated on a stool, playing the piano and focusing on sheet music. The background has textured shading.

artworks.title: En train de charmer toute une société ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: In the image, a person stands with raised hands, appearing to speak or sing. The individual has distinctive facial features with an open mouth, expressive eyes, and mid-length dark hair brushed back. The person wears a dark jacket, white shirt, and a bow tie. Two seated women listen nearby. The background includes loosely sketched lines indicating an audience and hanging decorations. The setting seems to be indoors with decorative lighting fixtures above.
